description: Which cable drum (reel) a length of cable needs, or how much one drum takes: whole layers and whole turns on a wound diameter of 1.05 x OD with a freeboard under the flange rim, an estimate within a few per cent of cable makers' own capacity tables (most online tools overstate by 20 to 40 %). Drums are KTG, NEMA, Turkish and makers' own sizes as their makers print them, each with its source; the barrel check uses the KTG minimum barrel table, and the cable's datasheet wins; a load rating is the maker's own. Free, deterministic, no LLM.

D.description: A drum by its dimensions: flange diameter, mm.

W.description: Winding width between the flanges, mm.

d.description: Barrel diameter, mm, less than D.

freeboard.description: Freeboard to the flange rim, mm. Default max(50 mm, one wound diameter).

kg.description: Cable mass, kg/km: gives cable and gross (cable + tare) kg per drum and the maker's load check.

kind.description: Cable kind for the smallest barrel (KTG table, x OD): flexible 12, lv-multi 15, lv-single 20, mv-multi 20, mv-single 25, hv 25, telecom 20, paper-lead 30. Default lv-multi.

max.description: Most drums of one size the length may be split over. Default 1.

od.description: Cable outer diameter, mm (a flat cable: its larger side).

system.description: Drum family: KTG (Europe), NEMA (North America), TR (Turkish makers), maker (one maker's own sizes) or all. Default all.

name: drum_fit
title: Find the cable drum a length needs
